Faithful, believing.
--द्धं
1 A

honour of the departed spirits of
dead relatives; श्रद्धया दीयते
यस्मात्तस्माच्छ्राद्धं निगद्यते; it is of three
kinds:
--नित्य, नैमित्तिक, and काम्य.
--2
An obsequial oblation, a gift or

--क्रिया a funeral ceremony.

funeral rite.

relative in whose honour a

progenitor.

श्रद्धालु a. [श्रद्धा --आलुच्]
1
Believing, full of faith.
--2 Desirous,
longing or wishing for (anything);
अकालकुसुमसमुद्गमश्रद्धालुता भर्त्रा
Ratn. 1

.
--लुः f. A pregnant woman longing
for anything.

श्रंथ् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (श्रंथते)
1 To be weak.
--2 To be loose or relaxed.
--3 To

1 To
loosen, liberate, release.
--2 To
delight repeatedly.

--2
Looseness.
--3 Binding, tying

1 Loosing, untying.
--2
Hurting, killing, destroying.
--3
Tying, binding.

श्रंथित p. p.
1 Loosed, liberated,
let loose.
--2 Connected; strung or
bound together.
--3 Hurt,
injured.
--4 Overcome, overpowered.
--5
Delighted.

boiling, seething.

श्रपणं --णा Causing to boil,
boiling, seething.

श्रपित p. p.
1 Boiled or caused to
be boiled.
--2 Seethed.
--तं Boiled
meat &c.
--ता Rice gruel.

श्रम् {c4c} P. (श्राम्यति, श्रांत)
1 To exert
oneself, take pains, toil, labour.
--2
To perform austerities, mortify the
body (by acts of penance); कियच्चिरं
श्राम्यसि गौरि

.
--3 To be
wearied or fatigued, be exhausted;
रतिश्रांता शेते रजानिरमणी गाढमुरमि
K.

.
--4
To be afflicted or distressed; यो
वृंदानि त्वरयति पथि श्राम्यतां प्रोषितानां
Me. 99

. --Caus. (श्र श्रा-मयति-ते)
To cause to be fatigued &c.

श्रमः [श्रम्-घञ्-न वृद्धिः]
1 Toil,
labour, exertion, effort; अलं महीपाल
तव श्रमेण

; जानाति हि पुनः
सम्यक् कविरेव कवेः श्रमं Subhāṣ.;

.
--2 Weariness,
fatigue, exhaustion; विनयंते स्म
तद्योधा मधुभिर्विजयश्रमं

.
--3 Affliction,
distress.
--4 Penance, austerity,
mortification of the body; दिवं यदि
प्रार्थयसे वृथा श्रमः

.
--5 (a)
Exercise; अयोदंडेन च श्रममकरोत्

. (b) Especially, military
exercise, drill.
--6 Hard study.
--Comp.
--अंबु n.,
--जलं perspiration, sweat.
--कर्षित a. worn out by fatigue.
--साध्य a. to be accomplished by
dint of labour.
--स्थानं a drill-ground,
gymnasium &c.

--2 Time.
--3

[]

श्रमिन् a.

--2 Undergoing fatigue or

--3 Tiring, fatiguing.
